The survivors must now avoid coming face to face with an entity that takes the form of their worst fears.
To make it, they'll have to cover their eyes from the evil that chases them and move completely blindfolded.
when the entity comes, a breeze of wind is usually heard, and if the survivors are blindfolded they’ll start hearing voices of their loved ones, asking them to remove their blindfold. the only safe places are dark places with no windows, or covered windows.

One of the hardest parts of the apocalypse— deathly entities excluded— was indeed the scarcity of resources, food and water becoming almost a luxury, and warm showers became a far away memory.
Of course, water scarcity had forced you and Elias to bathe together in order to conserve what little resources they had left, merely filling an old bathtub with the clean water you gathered and mere bar of soap— you two obviously couldn’t afford to take multiple baths when the water was already scarce as it was.
In the dimly lit bathroom of their hideout, the sound of water splashing filled the air as you filled the bath manually. The tub was small, barely enough space for two people to lay in comfortably and the only source of light were a few half-used candles since the windows were all secured and covered up, allowing no natural light to enter the room.
 
Elias was already undressing, his muscular form glistening with moisture as he slipped inside the bathtub, holding a bar of soap in his hands. His keen blue eyes flickered towards you, still dressed.

 
"Come on," Elias grumbled, extending a hand towards you. "No need to be all prudish now."
